scope: Eight-GPU (TP4xPP2 + dual-NUMA CPU Engram offload) production deployment and lossless optimization evaluation (Speed9) of DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017 official original weights on eight RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Server Edition 96 GB GPUs.

hardware.gpus: 8 x NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Server Edition 96 GB (all PCIe 5.0 x16 under load)
hardware.numa_mapping: GPUs 0-3 (PP Stage 0, layers 0-19) on NUMA 0; GPUs 4-7 (PP Stage 1, layers 20-39 + DSpark) on NUMA 1

model.note: Official original DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017 weights. Refusal rates were not evaluated.

short_prompt_t0.protocol: Temperature 0, thinking disabled, 1,024-token output budget. C1 reports median single-stream decode tok/s; C4/C8/C10 report median batch aggregate tok/s.

short_prompt_t1_c1.note: Default production sampling (temperature=1.0, top_p=1.0) C1 decode speed compared with prior unoptimized TP4xPP2 reference.

cold_prefill_single.protocol: Unique salted prompts, zero prefix-cache hits, random fact retrieval required.

historical_capacity_24x1m_20261109.note: Archived 2026-11-09 24-session simultaneous capacity proof under the same 36 GiB/GPU (288 GiB total) FP8 KV and 24-slot envelope.

single_1m_hold.note: Different prompt/output distribution from short-prompt benchmarks; not comparable as a short-input speedup.

wo_a_microbench_tp4.shape: groups=2, N=2048, K=4096 on RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell

rejected_candidates.name: P2P_AR_FUSED_MAX_ROWS=32
rejected_candidates.reason: One-shot PCIe push congested above M=8, regressing C4/C8 decode by 5-14%. Kept at 8.

rejected_candidates.name: VLLM_MOET_MOE_MEGA=1
rejected_candidates.reason: Microbench measured 162.85 us vs 160.95 us separate launch (+1.9 us/layer slower). Kept at 0.

rejected_candidates.name: max_num_batched_tokens=16384
rejected_candidates.reason: 1M cold prefill TTFT regressed from 56.48 s to 59.34 s. Reverted to 8192.

rejected_candidates.name: cand5-ws19-ws23-mxfp8tune
rejected_candidates.reason: Eliminated FlashInfer autotune warnings and trimmed 1M cold TTFT by 0.21 s (35.94 s vs 36.17 s), but C1 slowed ~0.9% and long_quality failed 1/12 (id=5 1M non-thinking sum produced 10466610 instead of 1046610 on the same prompt Cand4 passed).

rejected_candidates.name: cpu_ram_l2_kv_offload_connector
rejected_candidates.reason: Refused alongside PREFILL_PIPE=2 (historically +31% 163K cold prefill regression), replicated_layout is restricted to pp_size==1, NUMA 0 is occupied by ~189 GiB CPU Engram, and 36 GiB/GPU already holds 24x1M contexts in GPU VRAM.
